Bearprompt

Your private prompt library, with curated public prompts and agent collections.

Create your prompt library on bearprompt.com.

## Features - **Private library**: Store your own prompts locally in the browser with no signup required. - **Folders, search, and tags**: Organize prompts by folder, search quickly, and filter by tags. - **Public prompt library**: Browse curated public prompts, featured categories, and highlighted authors. - **Agent library**: Explore public agent collections and author pages. - **Share prompts**: Share prompts with end-to-end encrypted links (just like Excalidraw). ## How It Works Bearprompt has two main parts: - **Your private library** lives in the browser and is stored locally using IndexedDB. - **Public discovery features** such as prompts, agents, authors, and categories are served from Supabase. This means the app is privacy-first for personal usage, while still supporting a public library experience. ## Getting Started ### Prerequisites - Node.js 22+ and npm ### Installation ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/julianyaman/bearprompt.git cd bearprompt # Install dependencies npm install ``` ### Development ```bash # Start development server npm run dev # Open http://localhost:5173 in your browser ``` ### Available Scripts ```bash # Start the dev server npm run dev # Build for production npm run build # Preview the production build npm run preview # Type-check the project npm run check # Type-check in watch mode npm run check:watch ``` ### Environment Variables Create a `.env` file based on `.env.example`: ```bash cp .env.example .env ``` Current environment variables: - `SUPABASE_URL`: Supabase project URL - `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`: client-side key for public reads and app usage - `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`: server-side key for privileged operations - `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`: optional Cloudflare Turnstile secret for risk-based verification - `PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY`: optional public Turnstile site key For purely local UI work, you can often develop without the optional Turnstile keys. Public library and publishing-related features depend on Supabase. ### Build ```bash # Build for production npm run build ``` ## Docker Deployment Build and run with Docker: ```bash # Build the image docker build -t bearprompt . # Run the container docker run -p 3000:3000 bearprompt ``` The container runs the SvelteKit Node build with `node build` and will be available at `http://localhost:3000`. ## Tech Stack - **SvelteKit 2** with **Svelte 5** - **Tailwind CSS 4** - **Supabase** for public content and server-backed features - **IndexedDB** for the local private library - **@vercel/og** for Open Graph image generation ## Privacy Model - **Private library data** is stored locally in the browser. - **Public library content** is fetched from Supabase. - **Shared links** are end-to-end encrypted and use Cloudflare Turnstile for abuse prevention. If you self-host, review your Supabase and verification configuration carefully before exposing public flows. ## Contributing Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit issues and pull requests. 1. Fork the repository 2. Create your feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`) 3. Commit your changes using Conventional Commits, for example `feat(public): add category card hover state` 4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`) 5. Open a Pull Request Commit messages in this repo follow: ```text (): ``` Examples: - `feat(public): add featured category cards` - `fix(library): sort prompts alphabetically` - `docs(landing): update hero copy` ## License This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

---
title: "How to Add Custom AI Providers"
slug: "custom-ai-providers"
description: "Connect web chat tools and desktop agents like Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT Desktop, then open prompts from Bearprompt with one click."
publishedAt: "2026-08-08"
updatedAt: "2026-08-10"
author: "Bearprompt"
tags:
  - ai providers
  - settings
  - workflows
  - desktop agents
category: "Product Updates"
featured: true
---

Custom AI providers let you open prompts in the chat tools and coding agents you actually use—not only the built-in web options.

If a tool accepts a prompt through a URL query parameter (HTTPS or a supported desktop deep link), you can add it in Settings and it will show up in every **Open in…** menu.

## Why this exists

New chat UIs and coding agents appear often. Hardcoding each one does not scale, and your preferred tools may not match the defaults.

Bearprompt opens prompts in ChatGPT (web), Claude, Perplexity, Grok, **Cursor**, **Claude Code**, and **ChatGPT (Desktop)**. Custom providers use the same idea: build a URL, put your prompt in a query parameter, and open it.

Everything stays local. Provider settings are stored in your browser with the rest of your private library.

## Desktop agents (Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT Desktop)

These built-ins use **custom URL schemes** (deep links) so the OS can open a locally installed app with your prompt pre-filled. Nothing is sent to the model until you confirm in the app.

| Tool | Default URL template |
| --- | --- |
| Cursor | `cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/prompt?text={{prompt}}` |
| Claude Code | `claude-cli://open?q={{prompt}}` |
| ChatGPT (Desktop) | `codex://new?prompt={{prompt}}` |

**ChatGPT** (web) and **ChatGPT (Desktop)** are different entries: one opens chat.openai.com in the browser; the other opens the ChatGPT desktop app via the `codex://` deep link OpenAI still uses for compatibility.

They are **enabled by default**. Hide any you do not use under **Settings → AI Tools**.

Notes:

- The app must be installed and registered with your OS (Claude Code registers its handler after you send a prompt in an interactive session at least once).
- If the app is missing, the link may do nothing or show an OS error — that is expected.
- Desktop deep links allow longer prompts than typical HTTPS chat URLs before Bearprompt warns you.

Official docs: [Cursor deeplinks](https://cursor.com/docs/reference/deeplinks), [Claude Code deep links](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/deep-links), [ChatGPT / Codex deep links](https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/commands#deep-links).

## Add a provider in Settings

1. Open **Settings** → **AI Tools**.
2. Under **Add custom provider**, enter a name (for example, `My Chat`).
3. Enter a URL template that includes `{{prompt}}` where the prompt text should go.
4. Click **Test** to open a sample prompt, then **Add provider**.

Example (web):

```text
https://chat.example.com/?q={{prompt}}
```

Example (desktop — only if you need a custom variant):

```text
cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/prompt?text={{prompt}}
```

When you open a prompt, Bearprompt replaces `{{prompt}}` with the encoded prompt text.

You can also use `%q` as a shorter alias for the same placeholder:

```text
https://chat.example.com/?q=%q
```

## Manage built-in and custom tools

In **AI Tools** you can:

- **Show / Hide** any provider so it no longer appears in Open in…
- **Reorder** providers with the up/down controls
- **Edit** the name or URL template
- **Reset** a built-in provider to its default URL
- **Delete** custom providers you no longer need

The first two enabled providers appear as primary buttons on public prompt pages. The rest sit under **More**.

## Tips

- Templates must use `http`, `https`, `cursor`, `claude-cli`, or `codex`, and must include `{{prompt}}` or `%q`.
- Very long prompts can hit URL limits. If that happens, copy the prompt and paste it into the tool instead.
- Exporting your library includes your AI provider settings, so backups and imports can bring them along.

## Related

- [How to Use Prompt Variables](/blog/prompt-variables)
- [Settings](/settings)
- [Help](/help)

# Awesome FLUX 3 Prompts

Una colección de **48 prompts de producción para FLUX 3**: cine, publicidad, ecommerce, educación, viajes, deporte, arquitectura, UGC, documental, animación, audio nativo, diálogo multilingüe y flujos con referencias.

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 12 idiomas

> [!IMPORTANT] > FLUX 3 se publica por fases. FLUX 3 Video está disponible; FLUX 3 Image y los componentes de pesos abiertos siguen un calendario distinto. Verifica el acceso actual en la [página oficial](https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3). Las escenas, los textos, los prompts y las imágenes de este repositorio se han creado desde cero. Las imágenes son fotogramas conceptuales originales; no son muestras oficiales ni resultados de benchmark. ## El equipo de Flaq AI y la API de FLUX 3 [Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/about/) es una plataforma de IA multimodelo operada por FLAQ AI PTE. LTD. Su equipo trabaja en producto y plataforma, ingeniería de modelos y API, y flujos creativos prácticos para ayudar a desarrolladores, equipos creativos y empresas a pasar del descubrimiento a la integración en producción. - [Texto a vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/) — crea una escena nueva desde una descripción. - [Imagen a vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/) — anima producto, personaje, arte o imagen principal. - [Extensión de vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/) — continúa la acción, la cámara, el sonido y la lógica de un clip. - [Fotogramas inicial/final a vídeo](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/) — construye una transición controlada entre dos imágenes. La [guía completa de la API FLUX 3 de Flaq AI](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md) incluye nombres de modelo y campos exactos, ejemplos en JavaScript y cURL, consulta de estado, errores, seguridad de claves y prácticas de producción. ## Biblioteca | Colección | Prompts | Casos de uso | | --- | ---: | --- | | [Narrativa cinematográfica](prompts/cinematic-storytelling.md) | 4 | historias, varias tomas, plano secuencia | | [Publicidad y UGC](prompts/advertising-ugc.md) | 4 | producto, vídeo vertical, contenido de creador | | [Documental y naturaleza](prompts/documentary-nature.md) | 4 | observación, fauna, explicación | | [Animación y diseño](prompts/animation-design.md) | 4 | stop motion, anime, motion graphics | | [Audio multilingüe](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) | 4 | diálogo, acentos, música, cambio de idioma | | [Flujos con referencias](prompts/reference-workflows.md) | 4 | imagen a vídeo, keyframes, continuación, identidad | | [Ecommerce y producto](prompts/ecommerce-product.md) | 4 | montaje, joyería, skincare, interfaces SaaS | | [Viajes y hospitalidad](prompts/travel-hospitality.md) | 4 | habitaciones, diario local, accesibilidad, gastronomía | | [Deporte y bienestar](prompts/sports-wellness.md) | 4 | seguridad, running, técnica, movimiento adaptado | | [Educación y ciencia](prompts/education-science.md) | 4 | física, salud, pronunciación, museos | | [Arquitectura y movilidad](prompts/architecture-mobility.md) | 4 | inmobiliaria, trenes, carga, logística | | [Social y experimental](prompts/social-experimental.md) | 4 | memes, podcast, juegos originales, croma | ## Plantilla recomendada ```text OBJETIVO: [qué debe entender o sentir el público] FORMATO: [relación de aspecto], [duración], [audio sí/no] ENTRADAS: [Imagen 1 = identidad; Imagen 2 = estilo; Clip 1 = movimiento] MUNDO: [lugar, hora, clima, materiales y reglas físicas] BLOQUEO DEL SUJETO: [rostro, ropa, geometría y detalles invariables] CRONOLOGÍA: [por intervalos: plano + cámara + una acción + transición] AUDIO: [idioma, frase exacta entre comillas, ambiente, Foley y música] CONTINUIDAD: [luz, geografía, dirección, ropa y estado de los objetos] TEXTO: mostrar una sola vez: "[copia exacta]". EVITAR: [deriva, sujetos extra, física imposible, texto extra, marca de agua] ``` Ejemplo de diálogo exacto: ```text IDIOMA: español de México. La protagonista dice exactamente: "No llegamos tarde; llegamos cuando empezó la lluvia." Interpretación natural, íntima, sin voz publicitaria. No traducir, parafrasear, repetir, subtitular ni añadir palabras. ``` Consulta [Audio multilingüe](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) y el [conjunto de pruebas en español](i18n/es-ES.md). También están disponibles el [índice de 48 prompts](prompts/README.md), la [matriz de casos de uso](docs/use-case-matrix.md), la [guía avanzada](docs/prompting-guide.md) y la [guía de la API de Flaq AI](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md). La portada en inglés incluye cinco prompts completos con imágenes conceptuales originales. ## Programa de afiliados de Flaq AI Desarrolladores, creadores, educadores, autores de agentes y analistas de modelos pueden registrarse en el [programa de afiliados de Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/), crear un enlace personal de recomendación y obtener comisión por pedidos referidos que cumplan los requisitos. Las condiciones públicas actuales ofrecen un **20 % sobre el primer pedido de pago válido** del usuario referido y un **10 % sobre los pedidos de pago válidos posteriores** realizados dentro de los 60 días siguientes a su registro. El pago final depende de la atribución, reembolsos, contracargos, revisión de riesgo, política vigente y condiciones de colaboración aprobadas. Consulta la [guía para afiliados](docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md) y declara siempre la relación de afiliación. ## Palabras clave prompts FLUX 3, FLUX3 vídeo, generación de vídeo con IA, texto a vídeo, imagen a vídeo, audio nativo, diálogo multilingüe, cine, anuncios, ecommerce, UGC, educación, viajes, inmobiliaria, deporte, keyframes, continuidad de personaje, continuación de vídeo, programa de afiliados Flaq AI

# Awesome FLUX 3 提示词库

48 个可直接改造使用的 FLUX 3 生产级提示词，覆盖电影叙事、原生音频、多语言对白、广告电商、教育、旅行、运动、建筑交通、动画、世界构建与参考素材工作流。

English · 日本語 · Español · 12 种语言

> [!IMPORTANT] > FLUX 3 正在分阶段开放。FLUX 3 Video 已可用，FLUX 3 Image 与开放权重组件采用独立发布节奏。正式使用前请以 [FLUX 3 官方页面](https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3) 的最新说明为准。 本项目中的场景、标题、描述、提示词与预览图片均为本仓库重新创作。图片只用于表达场景方向，不是官方样例、模型跑分或特定 FLUX 3 生成结果。 ## 关于 Flaq AI 团队与 FLUX 3 API [Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/about/) 是由 FLAQ AI PTE. LTD. 运营的多模型 AI 平台。团队覆盖产品与平台、模型与 API 工程、创意工作流三个方向，帮助开发者、创意团队与企业从模型发现、效果验证走向实际集成与生产使用。 本提示词库可直接适配 Flaq AI 提供的四种 FLUX 3 工作流： - [文生视频](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-text-to-video/)：从文字创建新场景、广告、解说或多语言对白视频。 - [图生视频](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-to-video/)：让产品图、角色图、主视觉或艺术作品产生可控运动。 - [视频续写](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-video-extend/)：从原视频最后状态继续动作、镜头、声音和故事节奏。 - [首尾帧生视频](https://flaq.ai/models/black-forest-labs/flux-3-start-end-to-video/)：控制起点与终点，适合转场、产品揭示、前后变化与匹配镜头。 查看[完整 Flaq AI FLUX 3 API 指南](docs/flaq-ai-flux-3-api.md)，其中包含准确的模型名称、请求字段、JavaScript 与 cURL 示例、任务轮询、异常处理、密钥安全和生产检查清单。 ## 提示词目录 | 分类 | 数量 | 场景 | | --- | ---: | --- | | [电影叙事](prompts/cinematic-storytelling.md) | 4 | 多镜头短片、氛围叙事、喜剧、连续镜头 | | [广告与 UGC](prompts/advertising-ugc.md) | 4 | 产品片、竖屏社媒、创作者内容、美食广告 | | [纪录片与自然](prompts/documentary-nature.md) | 4 | 观察式纪录、野生动物、科普、历史重建 | | [动画与设计](prompts/animation-design.md) | 4 | 定格动画、动漫、动态图形、VFX 字幕 | | [多语言音频](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) | 4 | 对白、口音、音乐表演、多语言切换 | | [参考素材工作流](prompts/reference-workflows.md) | 4 | 图生视频、关键帧、视频续写、角色一致性 | | [电商与产品](prompts/ecommerce-product.md) | 4 | 组装证明、珠宝、护肤 UGC、SaaS 界面 | | [旅行与酒店](prompts/travel-hospitality.md) | 4 | 客房展示、本地日记、无障碍旅行、美食编辑 | | [运动与健康](prompts/sports-wellness.md) | 4 | 攀岩安全、跑步、网球分析、适应性运动 | | [教育与科学](prompts/education-science.md) | 4 | 物理、健康素养、语言学习、博物馆解读 | | [建筑与交通](prompts/architecture-mobility.md) | 4 | 房产、轨道换乘、充电、末端物流 | | [社媒与实验](prompts/social-experimental.md) | 4 | 冷面段子、播客、原创游戏、绿幕素材 | ## 适合 FLUX 3 的提示词结构 FLUX 3 不只是生成一个漂亮画面。视频提示词最好同时控制以下内容： 1. **世界规则**：地点、时间、天气、材质、光源与物理逻辑。 2. **主体锁定**：面部、服装、比例、主产品与不能漂移的细节。 3. **时间线**：用时间段拆分动作，每个段落只安排一个主要事件。 4. **镜头逻辑**：景别、移动方式、焦点、运动轴与转场原因。 5. **声音因果**：对白语言、精确台词、环境声、拟音、音乐进入和退出。 6. **文字排版**：把文字放在引号中，规定语言、位置、材质和出现时长。 7. **禁止项**：多余人物、身份漂移、道具跳变、不可能物理、额外字幕与水印。 完整模板： ```text 目标：[观众最终应该理解或感受到什么] 格式：[画幅]，[时长]，[音频开启/关闭] 输入：[图片 1 = 角色参考；图片 2 = 风格参考；视频 1 = 动作参考] 世界：[地点、时间、天气、布景、物理规则] 主体锁定：[身份、服装、产品几何、全程不变的细节] 视觉语言：[媒介、镜头质感、色彩、纹理、真实程度] 时间线： 00:00-00:__ — [景别 + 运镜 + 一个明确动作 + 转场] 00:__-00:__ — [下一段；保持运动方向与道具状态] 00:__-00:__ — [结果与结尾画面] 音频： - 对白：[语言、引号中的精确台词、语气和停顿] - 环境：[持续的空间底噪] - 拟音：[与可见动作同步的声音] - 音乐：[乐器、进入/退出时机；或明确不要音乐] 连续性：[光源、空间、身份、服装、道具、动作] 文字：只出现一次："[精确文案]"。[位置、字体气质、时长] 避免：[漂移、多余主体、错误物理、无意义快剪、额外文字、水印] ``` ## 多语言写法 制作指令可以统一使用中文或英文，把需要精确输出的对白独立出来： ```text 对白语言：日语。 角色 A 只说这一句："今日は、遠回りして帰ろう。" 语气：自然、轻声、带一点犹豫，不要广告播音腔。 不要翻译、改写、重复、自动加字幕或添加其他台词。 ``` [多语言音频包](prompts/multilingual-audio.md) 还包含中文、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、法语、阿拉伯语、印地语、韩语和语言切换示例。另有 [简体中文完整测试集](i18n/zh-CN.md)，可与其他 11 种语言使用统一场景 ID 横向比较。 ## 快速入口 - # Original image prompts and provenance

All six images in this directory were generated specifically for this repository with the built-in image generation tool, then converted to WebP for faster GitHub rendering. They are concept frames, not FLUX 3 outputs or benchmark evidence.

## `flux-3-prompts-hero.webp`

```text
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: repository hero image, wide 16:9
Primary request: an original cinematic contact sheet showing the creative range of a next-generation multimodal visual model
Scene/backdrop: one seamless wide composition divided by natural light and geometry into four connected worlds: a rain-soaked neon night market documentary, a clean luxury product studio with a sculptural glass fragrance bottle, a hand-built stop-motion paper universe, and an immense desert science-fiction landscape
Style/medium: premium editorial key art, photorealistic with subtle tactile mixed-media transitions
Composition/framing: panoramic, balanced four-scene montage, clear focal rhythm, generous clean margins, no hard panel borders
Lighting/mood: electric cyan and amber accents, cinematic contrast, sophisticated and inviting
Materials/textures: wet pavement, brushed metal, translucent glass, handmade paper fibers, windblown sand
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no user interface, all concepts original
```

## `featured/rainy-noodle-documentary.webp`

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: featured prompt concept frame, wide 16:9
Primary request: a tiny late-night noodle stall seen through monsoon rain, focused on the quiet human craft of cooking
Scene/backdrop: narrow Southeast Asian alley at night, rainwater running along the curb, steam drifting under a patched awning
Subject: an older street-food cook in a faded teal apron tossing noodles in a blackened wok, one customer waiting beneath a clear umbrella
Style/medium: observational documentary photography, natural and unposed
Composition/framing: eye-level medium-wide shot from across the alley, foreground raindrops caught by a streetlight, layered depth
Lighting/mood: warm tungsten stall light against cool blue rain, intimate, humane, calm
Materials/textures: worn enamel bowls, steam, rain-slick concrete, aged fabric, real skin texture
Constraints: physically plausible hands and cooking tools, no text, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no glamorized studio polish
```

## `featured/storm-glass-product-ad.webp`

```text
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: featured advertising concept frame, vertical 4:5
Primary request: an original luxury fragrance campaign built around the idea of rain captured inside glass
Scene/backdrop: dark mineral stone plinth in a minimalist storm-lit studio, suspended droplets and a thin sheet of water
Subject: one unbranded asymmetrical clear-glass fragrance bottle with a silver cap, pale blue liquid refracting light
Style/medium: premium commercial product photography with practical liquid effects
Composition/framing: centered three-quarter hero angle, strong silhouette, usable negative space above, subtle reflection below
Lighting/mood: cool lightning-shaped rim light, soft white key light, restrained, elegant, mysterious
Materials/textures: flawless glass, brushed silver, wet basalt, crisp droplets
Constraints: no label text, no logo, no trademark, no watermark, no duplicate bottle, realistic refraction and contact shadow
```

## `featured/salt-garden-worldbuilding.webp`

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: featured worldbuilding concept frame, wide 16:9
Primary request: a lone courier crossing a dried ocean while carrying a portable garden
Scene/backdrop: immense white salt basin under a pale green sky, distant skeletons of wind turbines half buried in mineral crust
Subject: practical desert courier in layered weathered clothing, walking beside a compact two-wheeled cart containing a small luminous greenhouse full of living herbs
Style/medium: grounded science-fiction production concept art with photoreal materials
Composition/framing: low wide shot, courier placed off-center, long footprints and cart tracks leading toward the horizon
Lighting/mood: hard late-afternoon sun, quiet hope, vast scale, windblown haze
Materials/textures: salt crystals, scratched aluminum, dusty canvas, translucent greenhouse panels, fresh green leaves
Constraints: believable engineering and scale, no weapons, no text, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, original character design
```

## `featured/multilingual-motion-poster.webp`

```text
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: featured motion-design concept frame, vertical 4:5
Primary request: an original experimental typography poster about creative momentum
Scene/backdrop: deep charcoal field with layered translucent ribbons and precise kinetic grid lines
Subject: large dimensional typography integrated into the composition
Style/medium: contemporary Swiss-inspired motion design still, tactile paper and glass materials, refined editorial spacing
Composition/framing: bold vertical hierarchy, one dominant title and three small language lines, generous margins
Lighting/mood: crisp studio light, energetic but controlled
Color palette: electric coral, cobalt blue, warm white, charcoal
Text (verbatim): "MAKE IT MOVE" and beneath it exactly once each: "让灵感流动" "創造を動かす" "DA VIDA A TUS IDEAS"
Constraints: render all four phrases exactly, readable, no extra text, no logo, no trademark, no watermark, original layout
```

## `featured/moon-tea-stop-motion.webp`

```text
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: featured stop-motion concept frame, wide 16:9
Primary request: a handmade stop-motion scene of a midnight tea ceremony on a tiny paper moon
Scene/backdrop: miniature indigo cosmos made from layered paper, stitched stars, and soft cotton nebulae
Subject: two small original felt characters sitting opposite each other at a low round table; one pours glowing amber tea while the other watches a paper comet pass
Style/medium: handcrafted stop-motion miniature, visible paper fibers, felt seams, slightly imperfect handmade charm
Composition/framing: intimate medium-wide shot, moon curve filling the lower frame, comet arc guiding the eye
Lighting/mood: warm practical lantern light against cool blue space, whimsical, tender, quiet
Materials/textures: felt, folded paper, embroidery thread, carved wood, translucent resin tea
Constraints: no text, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no existing franchise characters, physically plausible miniature set
```

# FLUX 3 prompting guide: from idea to usable shot

FLUX 3 prompts work best as compact directing briefs. This guide turns a vague idea into a testable prompt without pretending that prompt text alone replaces production judgment.

## 1. Choose the generation mode before writing

| You already have | Use this strategy | Lock first |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Only an idea or script | Text-to-video | world, subject description, timeline |
| A product, person, illustration, or first frame | Image-to-video | identity, geometry, composition, light |
| Several images with different jobs | Multi-reference | one role per image; reject cross-contamination |
| Required visual milestones | Ordered keyframes | exact order, target times, invariant geometry |
| A clip whose action should continue | Video continuation | final frame, momentum, camera, exposure, audio bed |
| A clip whose style or context should change | Video-to-video | source elements to preserve vs transform |

Do not ask every reference to control everything. A useful role statement looks like this:

```text
Image 1 controls identity and wardrobe only.
Image 2 controls environment, time of day, and palette only.
Clip 1 controls camera path and movement timing only.
Do not import people, text, logos, or props from style and motion references.
```

## 2. Define the end frame early

The last three to five seconds determine whether a clip is editable. Decide whether the ending should:

- hold a product hero angle;
- settle on a readable title;
- provide negative space for post-production copy;
- match the start frame for a loop;
- preserve motion for continuation;
- stop in silence for an editorial cut.

If the final frame matters, describe camera deceleration, subject behavior, prop state, and hold duration. “End cinematically” is not actionable.

## 3. Write a readable timeline

Each time range should contain one main action and one camera intention. A practical 20-second structure is:

```text
00:00-00:05 — Establish the world and subject.
00:05-00:12 — Perform the primary action with visible cause and effect.
00:12-00:16 — Introduce a turn, response, or proof point.
00:16-00:20 — Decelerate into a deliberate final frame.
```

Avoid packing dialogue, camera orbit, costume change, object transformation, weather change, and title animation into the same four seconds.

## 4. Separate camera, subject, and environment motion

Write these as three independent layers:

```text
Camera: track backward at walking speed, chest height, never cross the action axis.
Subject: walk forward, open the umbrella once, then keep it open.
Environment: rain falls at a constant angle; trees and coat respond to the same crosswind.
```

This makes failures easier to diagnose. If a result feels unstable, remove one motion layer before adding adjectives.

## 5. Lock identity and product geometry

List only details that are visible and important:

- facial structure, age, hair, distinctive mark;
- body proportions and handedness;
- wardrobe layers, color, fasteners, accessories;
- product silhouette, part count, label area, fill level, material;
- object scale relative to hands and environment.

Repeat the lock after any major style change. Avoid vague instructions such as “keep everything the same.”

## 6. Prompt physical causality

Strong video feels causal: force precedes motion, sound follows impact, weight affects acceleration, and wetness accumulates instead of resetting.

Check:

- hands touch an object before it moves;
- wheels rotate at the distance traveled;
- liquid level, spill, and reflection remain consistent;
- cloth, hair, dust, and plants respond to the same wind;
- shadows and reflections share one light source;
- props stay where they were placed;
- the camera cannot pass through walls or people.

## 7. Design audio as four layers

```text
Dialogue: exact quoted words, language, voice character, pace, pauses.
Ambience: the continuous acoustic space.
Foley: visible causes—footsteps, fabric, tools, doors, water.
Music: instrument, tempo, entry, exit, and intensity; or explicitly none.
```

For multilingual speech, state what must not happen:

```text
Speak the quoted Japanese line exactly once.
Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, subtitle, or add words.
Natural conversational delivery; no announcer cadence.
```

## 8. Decide whether text belongs in generation

Generate text when it is visually central and short: a title, label, chapter card, or sign that interacts with the scene. Add text in post when it is legally sensitive, frequently updated, data-heavy, price-based, or needs exact brand typography.

When generating text:

```text
Render exactly once: "SEE IT. SOLVE IT."
Warm-white geometric sans serif, centered, stable for three seconds.
No extra words, translation, punctuation, logo, or decorative glyphs.
```

## 9. Build a useful avoid list

An avoid list should target likely failures, not repeat generic quality language.

Useful:

```text
Avoid: duplicate bottle, changing liquid level, cap drift, invented label,
warped reflection, extra copy, logo, watermark.
```

Less useful:

```text
Avoid: bad quality, ugly, mistakes, low resolution.
```

## 10. Iterate with one controlled change

Use a simple record:

| Version | Changed | Kept fixed | Result | Next decision |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| v1 | baseline | — | identity good; camera too fast | slow camera only |
| v2 | camera speed | identity, action, audio | stable; end frame short | add 3-second hold |
| v3 | end hold | everything else | usable | render final |

Do not rewrite the whole prompt after every result. One-change iteration preserves what already works.

## 11. Production review checklist

- The concept is original or properly licensed.
- Every reference has a declared role and usage rights.
- Identity, voice, logo, and location permissions are documented.
- Visible claims are supportable; medical, financial, and performance claims are reviewed.
- Dialogue, captions, and typography match the intended locale.
- Physics, continuity, hands, text, and reflections are reviewed frame by frame.
- Generated content is not presented as documentary evidence or an official benchmark.
- A human approves the final edit, audio mix, and release context.

## 12. Access and parameters

FLUX 3 capabilities, endpoints, duration, resolution bands, pricing, and available input modes may change during rollout. Use the [official FLUX 3 model page](https://bfl.ai/models/flux-3) and [official overview](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3) as the source of truth rather than copying old API examples into production.

## Format shortcuts

| Delivery | Suggested ratio | Prompt families |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Vertical social / UGC | 9:16 | A02, E03, T02, S01, X01 |
| Feed post / ecommerce | 4:5 or 1:1 | A03, E01, E02, L02, B03 |
| Standard editorial / education | 16:9 | D03, L01–L04, B01/B02/B04 |
| Cinematic / worldbuilding | 2:1, 2.39:1, 21:9 | C01/C04, D02, M03 |
| Post-production utility | source ratio or 16:9 | N03/N04, X04 |

## Risk shortcuts

| Risk | Test with a minimal prompt first |
| --- | --- |
| Identity drift | one person, one action, locked camera |
| Product redesign | 5-second orbit with no hands or effects |
| Broken typography | static short phrase before animation |
| Lip-sync failure | one speaker, one sentence, no camera move |
| Physics failure | one cause-and-effect action in a fixed shot |
| Reference contamination | add references one at a time with explicit roles |
| Spatial dishonesty | fixed doorway-to-window route before full walkthrough |
| Audio clutter | ambience + one Foley event before music and dialogue |

# مطالبات FLUX 3 بالعربية (`ar`)

ثلاثة مشاهد اختبار مترجمة بالكامل. يجب الحفاظ على المعرّفات والتوقيت وحركة الكاميرا والاستمرارية كما هي للمقارنة بين اللغات.

## I18N-01 — تقييم أداء نبتة المكتب

```text
التنسيق: عمودي 9:16، مدة 15 ثانية، كوميديا جافة، حوار عربي فصيح طبيعي.

المشهد: غرفة اجتماعات صغيرة وعادية وقت الظهيرة. موظفة متعبة ترتدي سترة بيج تجلس أمام نبتة مطاط سليمة. حاسوب محمول مغلق وكوب ماء ثابتان في منتصف الطاولة. كاميرا الهاتف ثابتة.

00:00-00:05 — تنظر إلى ورقة فارغة ثم إلى النبتة وتقول حرفيًا: «كان نموك هذا الربع استثنائيًا.»
00:05-00:10 — لقطة رد فعل طويلة للنبتة. تتحرك ورقة واحدة فقط عند تشغيل المكيّف.
00:10-00:15 — العودة إلى الموظفة. تدفع كوب الماء نحو النبتة وتقول حرفيًا: «سنزيد الموارد المتاحة لك.» تنتهي اللقطة بإيماءة جادة صغيرة.

الصوت: طنين الإضاءة، طابعة بعيدة، حوار طبيعي، احتكاك الكوب بالطاولة، صوت تشغيل المكيّف. بلا موسيقى أو ضحك مسجل.

تجنّب: وجه على النبتة، أشخاص إضافيون، ترجمة مكتوبة، كلمات إضافية، تغيّر الأدوات، شعار، علامة مائية.
```

## I18N-02 — تجميع في ثماني حركات

```text
الوضع: تحويل صورة إلى فيديو. الصورة 1 هي المرجع الوحيد للمنتج.
التنسيق: 4:5، مدة 20 ثانية، مؤثرات صوتية طبيعية.

ثبّت: طاولة جانبية من بلوط فاتح، سطح مثلث بحواف مستديرة، ثلاث أرجل مدببة، ثلاث حوامل سوداء، قفلان، عروق الخشب، النسب وعدد القطع.

00:00-00:04 — لقطة علوية. تظهر كل قطعة مرة واحدة في ترتيب تفكيكي واضح.
00:04-00:12 — لقطة قريبة بزاوية ثلاثة أرباع. أظهر ثماني حركات واضحة: إدخال ثلاثة حوامل، تركيب ثلاث أرجل، تدوير قفلين. لا تُخفِ نقاط التلامس بالقطع.
00:12-00:17 — اقلب الطاولة، اضغط كل زاوية مرة واحدة، ثم ضع كوب ماء ممتلئ لإظهار الثبات.
00:17-00:20 — لقطة منتج ثابتة مع مساحة فارغة على اليمين. لا تُنشئ نصًا.

الصوت: تلامس الخشب، نقرة معدنية، دوران الأقفال، وضع الطاولة، ملامسة الكوب. بلا صوت بشري أو موسيقى.

تجنّب: التجميع السحري، مسامير إضافية، أيدٍ غير طبيعية، تغيّر عروق الخشب، شعار، تعليق نصي، علامة مائية.
```

## I18N-03 — كيف تمتص المدينة مياه المطر

```text
التنسيق: 16:9، مدة 20 ثانية، نموذج تعليمي من الطين والراتنج الشفاف.

00:00-00:06 — يهطل المطر على حي صغير. تسير المياه الزرقاء في المجرى نحو فتحة الرصيف. النص الحرفي: «1 · التجميع».
00:06-00:13 — مقطع تحت الأرض. تعبر المياه ثلاث طبقات منفصلة، وكل تسمية تظهر مرة واحدة: «غطاء عضوي»، «تربة رملية»، «حصى».
00:13-00:20 — تتسرب المياه ببطء بين الجذور ويتوقف فيضان الشارع. النص الختامي الحرفي: «إبطاء · ترشيح · امتصاص».

التعليق الصوتي الحرفي: «تبطئ حديقة المطر جريان المياه، وتحجز الشوائب بالتربة والجذور، وتمنح الماء وقتًا ليتسرب إلى الأرض.»

# FLUX-3-Prompts auf Deutsch (`de-DE`)

Drei vollständig lokalisierte Testszenen. IDs, Timing und Kontinuität bleiben in allen Sprachen gleich.

## I18N-01 — Das Mitarbeitergespräch mit der Büropflanze

```text
FORMAT: 9:16, 15 Sekunden, trockene Komödie, Dialog auf natürlichem Hochdeutsch.

SZENE: Gewöhnlicher kleiner Besprechungsraum am Mittag. Eine müde Angestellte im beigefarbenen Cardigan sitzt einer gesunden Gummibaumpflanze gegenüber. Ein geschlossener Laptop und ein Wasserglas bleiben mittig auf dem Tisch. Starre Smartphone-Kamera.

00:00-00:05 — Sie betrachtet ein leeres Blatt, blickt zur Pflanze und sagt exakt: „Ihr Wachstum in diesem Quartal war außergewöhnlich.“
00:05-00:10 — Unangenehm langer Reaktionsshot der Pflanze. Ein Blatt bewegt sich nur, weil die Klimaanlage anspringt.
00:10-00:15 — Zurück zur Angestellten. Sie schiebt das Glas zur Pflanze und sagt exakt: „Wir erhöhen Ihre Ressourcen.“ Ende mit einem kleinen, ernsten Nicken.

AUDIO: Leises Neonbrummen, entfernter Drucker, natürlicher Dialog, Glas auf Tisch, Klimaanlagen-Klick. Keine Musik und keine Lachspur.

VERMEIDEN: Pflanze mit Gesicht, zusätzliche Personen, Untertitel, weitere Wörter, wechselnde Requisiten, Logo, Wasserzeichen.
```

## I18N-02 — Aufbau in acht Handgriffen

```text
MODUS: Bild-zu-Video. Bild 1 ist die einzige Produktreferenz.
FORMAT: 4:5, 20 Sekunden, natürliche Geräusche.

FESTLEGEN: Beistelltisch aus heller Eiche, abgerundete dreieckige Platte, drei konische Beine, drei schwarze Halterungen, zwei Verschlüsse, Maserung, Maße und Teilezahl.

00:00-00:04 — Draufsicht. Alle Teile liegen genau einmal in einer Explosionsdarstellung.
00:04-00:12 — Dreiviertel-Nahaufnahme. Acht klare Handgriffe: drei Halterungen einsetzen, drei Beine platzieren, zwei Verschlüsse drehen. Kontakt nie durch Schnitte verdecken.
00:12-00:17 — Tisch umdrehen, jede Ecke einmal belasten, dann ein volles Wasserglas aufstellen.
00:17-00:20 — Ruhige Produktansicht mit freier Fläche rechts. Keinen Text erzeugen.

AUDIO: Holz, Metallklick, Verschlüsse, Abstellen, Glas. Keine Stimme oder Musik.

VERMEIDEN: magische Selbstmontage, zusätzliche Schrauben, unmögliche Hände, wechselnde Maserung, Logo, Untertitel, Wasserzeichen.
```

## I18N-03 — Wie die Stadt Regen aufnimmt

```text
FORMAT: 16:9, 20 Sekunden, Erklärmodell aus Ton und transparentem Harz.

00:00-00:06 — Regen fällt auf einen Stadtblock. Blaues Wasser fließt in der Rinne zur Bordsteinöffnung. Exakte Beschriftung: „1 · SAMMELN“.
00:06-00:13 — Schnitt unter die Erde. Wasser passiert drei klar getrennte Schichten, jeweils einmal beschriftet: „MULCH“, „SANDIGER BODEN“, „KIES“.
00:13-00:20 — Wasser versickert langsam zwischen den Wurzeln; die Straße überflutet nicht mehr. Exakter Schlusstext: „BREMSEN · FILTERN · VERSICKERN“.

EXAKTE SPRECHERSTIMME: „Ein Regengarten bremst Abfluss, hält Schmutz in Boden und Wurzeln zurück und gibt dem Wasser Zeit, im Boden zu versickern.“

AUDIO: Leichter Regen, Modellgeräusche, klare Stimme, sehr leise Marimba.

VERMEIDEN: bergauf fließendes Wasser, falsche Leitungen, winzige Schrift, vollständige Schadstoffbeseitigung als Behauptung, Logo, Wasserzeichen.
```

# Prompts FLUX 3 en français (`fr-FR`)

Trois scènes de test entièrement localisées. Conserver les identifiants, la chronologie et les contraintes pour comparer les résultats entre langues.

## I18N-01 — L'entretien annuel de la plante

```text
FORMAT : 9:16, 15 secondes, comédie impassible, dialogue en français de France.

SCÈNE : Petite salle de réunion ordinaire à midi. Une employée fatiguée en cardigan beige est assise face à un ficus en bonne santé. Un ordinateur fermé et un verre d'eau restent au centre de la table. Caméra de téléphone fixe.

00:00-00:05 — Elle consulte une feuille blanche, regarde la plante et dit exactement : « Votre croissance ce trimestre est exceptionnelle. »
00:05-00:10 — Long plan de réaction sur la plante. Une feuille bouge uniquement parce que la climatisation démarre.
00:10-00:15 — Retour sur l'employée. Elle fait glisser le verre vers la plante et dit exactement : « Nous allons augmenter vos ressources. » Finir sur un petit signe de tête sérieux.

AUDIO : Néons, imprimante lointaine, dialogue naturel, verre sur la table, déclic de climatisation. Sans musique ni rires enregistrés.

ÉVITER : plante dotée d'un visage, collègues supplémentaires, sous-titres, texte additionnel, accessoires qui changent, logo, filigrane.
```

## I18N-02 — Montage en huit gestes

```text
MODE : Image-vers-vidéo. L'Image 1 est l'unique référence du produit.
FORMAT : 4:5, 20 secondes, bruitages natifs.

PRÉSERVER : Table d'appoint en chêne clair, plateau triangulaire arrondi, trois pieds fuselés, trois supports noirs, deux fixations, veinage, proportions et nombre de pièces.

00:00-00:04 — Vue du dessus. Toutes les pièces sont disposées une seule fois.
00:04-00:12 — Vue rapprochée en trois quarts. Montrer huit gestes lisibles : insérer trois supports, placer trois pieds, tourner deux fixations. Ne masquer aucun contact par une coupe.
00:12-00:17 — Retourner la table, appuyer une fois sur chaque coin, puis poser un verre plein pour montrer sa stabilité.
00:17-00:20 — Plan produit stable avec espace négatif à droite. Aucun texte généré.

AUDIO : Bois, clic métallique, fixations, table posée, verre. Sans voix ni musique.

ÉVITER : auto-assemblage magique, vis supplémentaires, mains impossibles, changement de bois, logo, légende, filigrane.
```

## I18N-03 — Comment la ville absorbe la pluie

```text
FORMAT : 16:9, 20 secondes, maquette explicative en argile et résine.

00:00-00:06 — La pluie tombe sur un pâté de maisons. L'eau bleue suit le caniveau vers l'ouverture du trottoir. Afficher exactement : « 1 · RECUEILLIR ».
00:06-00:13 — Coupe sous le sol. L'eau traverse trois couches clairement distinctes, étiquetées une seule fois : « PAILLIS », « SOL SABLEUX », « GRAVIER ».
00:13-00:20 — L'eau s'infiltre lentement autour des racines; la rue cesse de déborder. Texte final exact : « RALENTIR · FILTRER · INFILTRER ».

NARRATION EXACTE : « Un jardin de pluie ralentit le ruissellement, retient les débris grâce au sol et aux racines, et laisse à l'eau le temps de s'infiltrer. »

AUDIO : Pluie douce, texture de maquette, narration claire, quelques notes discrètes de marimba.

ÉVITER : eau qui monte, canalisations incorrectes, texte minuscule, promesse de dépollution totale, logo, filigrane.
```

## Programme d'affiliation Flaq AI

Les développeurs, créateurs et formateurs peuvent rejoindre le [programme d'affiliation Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/), créer un lien de parrainage personnel et recevoir une commission sur les commandes éligibles. Les conditions publiques actuelles prévoient **20 % sur la première commande payante valide** d'un utilisateur parrainé, puis **10 % sur les commandes payantes valides suivantes** effectuées dans les 60 jours après son inscription. Le paiement final dépend de l'attribution, des remboursements, des rétrofacturations, du contrôle des risques et de la politique en vigueur. Consultez le [guide d'affiliation](../docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md) et signalez clairement toute relation d'affiliation.

# Prompt FLUX 3 dalam Bahasa Indonesia (`id-ID`)

Tiga adegan uji yang dilokalkan sepenuhnya. Pertahankan ID, waktu, kamera, dan kontinuitas agar hasil antarbahasa dapat dibandingkan.

## I18N-01 — Evaluasi kinerja tanaman kantor

```text
FORMAT: 9:16, 15 detik, komedi datar, dialog Bahasa Indonesia yang alami.

ADEGAN: Ruang rapat kecil biasa pada siang hari. Seorang pegawai yang lelah dengan kardigan krem duduk berhadapan dengan tanaman karet yang sehat. Laptop tertutup dan segelas air tetap berada di tengah meja. Kamera ponsel terkunci.

00:00-00:05 — Ia memeriksa selembar kertas kosong, menatap tanaman, lalu berkata persis: "Pertumbuhan Anda kuartal ini luar biasa."
00:05-00:10 — Tahan gambar reaksi tanaman dengan sengaja terlalu lama. Satu daun bergerak hanya karena pendingin ruangan menyala.
00:10-00:15 — Kembali ke pegawai. Ia menggeser gelas ke arah tanaman lalu berkata persis: "Kami akan menambah sumber daya Anda." Akhiri dengan anggukan kecil yang serius.

AUDIO: Dengung lampu, printer jauh, dialog alami, gelas bergeser, klik pendingin ruangan. Tanpa musik atau suara tawa.

HINDARI: wajah pada tanaman, orang tambahan, subtitel, kata tambahan, properti berubah, logo, tanda air.
```

## I18N-02 — Dirakit dalam delapan gerakan

```text
MODE: Gambar-ke-video. Gambar 1 adalah satu-satunya acuan produk.
FORMAT: 4:5, 20 detik, Foley alami.

PERTAHANKAN: Meja samping kayu ek terang, permukaan segitiga membulat, tiga kaki meruncing, tiga braket hitam, dua pengunci, serat kayu, proporsi, dan jumlah bagian.

00:00-00:04 — Tampak atas. Semua bagian muncul tepat satu kali dalam susunan terurai.
00:04-00:12 — Close-up tiga perempat. Tampilkan delapan gerakan yang jelas: masukkan tiga braket, pasang tiga kaki, putar dua pengunci. Jangan menyembunyikan kontak dengan potongan gambar.
00:12-00:17 — Balik meja, tekan setiap sudut satu kali, lalu letakkan segelas penuh air untuk menunjukkan kestabilan.
00:17-00:20 — Gambar produk stabil dengan ruang kosong di kanan. Jangan hasilkan teks.

AUDIO: Kontak kayu, klik logam, pengunci, meja diletakkan, gelas. Tanpa suara atau musik.

# Prompt FLUX 3 in italiano (`it-IT`)

Tre scene di test completamente localizzate. ID, tempi, camera e continuità restano invariati per confrontare i risultati tra lingue.

## I18N-01 — La valutazione della pianta da ufficio

```text
FORMATO: 9:16, 15 secondi, commedia impassibile, dialogo in italiano naturale.

SCENA: Piccola sala riunioni ordinaria a mezzogiorno. Un'impiegata stanca con cardigan beige è seduta di fronte a una pianta di ficus sana. Un portatile chiuso e un bicchiere d'acqua restano al centro del tavolo. Camera del telefono fissa.

00:00-00:05 — Lei consulta un foglio bianco, guarda la pianta e dice esattamente: «La sua crescita in questo trimestre è stata eccezionale.»
00:05-00:10 — Inquadratura di reazione sulla pianta, volutamente lunga. Una foglia si muove solo quando parte l'aria condizionata.
00:10-00:15 — Torna sull'impiegata. Fa scivolare il bicchiere verso la pianta e dice esattamente: «Aumenteremo le risorse a sua disposizione.» Finire con un piccolo cenno serio.

AUDIO: Ronzio delle luci, stampante lontana, dialogo naturale, vetro sul tavolo, scatto del condizionatore. Niente musica o risate.

EVITARE: volto sulla pianta, persone aggiuntive, sottotitoli, altre parole, oggetti che cambiano, logo, filigrana.
```

## I18N-02 — Montaggio in otto movimenti

```text
MODALITÀ: Da immagine a video. L'Immagine 1 è l'unico riferimento del prodotto.
FORMATO: 4:5, 20 secondi, effetti sonori naturali.

PRESERVARE: Tavolino in rovere chiaro, piano triangolare arrotondato, tre gambe affusolate, tre staffe nere, due fermi, venatura, proporzioni e numero di componenti.

00:00-00:04 — Vista dall'alto. Ogni componente appare una sola volta in disposizione esplosa.
00:04-00:12 — Primo piano a tre quarti. Mostrare otto movimenti leggibili: inserire tre staffe, montare tre gambe, ruotare due fermi. Non nascondere il contatto con tagli.
00:12-00:17 — Girare il tavolo, premere ogni angolo una volta e appoggiare un bicchiere pieno per mostrare la stabilità.
00:17-00:20 — Inquadratura prodotto stabile con spazio libero a destra. Non generare testo.

AUDIO: Legno, clic metallico, fermi, tavolo appoggiato, bicchiere. Niente voce o musica.

EVITARE: autoassemblaggio magico, viti extra, mani impossibili, venatura variabile, logo, didascalia, filigrana.
```

## I18N-03 — Come la città assorbe la pioggia

```text
FORMATO: 16:9, 20 secondi, plastico esplicativo in argilla e resina trasparente.

00:00-00:06 — La pioggia cade su un isolato. L'acqua blu segue la grondaia stradale fino all'apertura del marciapiede. Testo esatto: «1 · RACCOGLIERE».
00:06-00:13 — Sezione sotterranea. L'acqua attraversa tre strati distinti, etichettati una sola volta: «PACCIAMATURA», «TERRENO SABBIOSO», «GHIAIA».
00:13-00:20 — L'acqua filtra lentamente tra le radici e la strada smette di allagarsi. Testo finale esatto: «RALLENTARE · FILTRARE · ASSORBIRE».

NARRAZIONE ESATTA: «Un giardino pluviale rallenta il deflusso, trattiene i detriti con il terreno e le radici e dà all'acqua il tempo di infiltrarsi.»

AUDIO: Pioggia leggera, suoni del plastico, narrazione chiara, marimba molto discreta.

EVITARE: acqua in salita, tubi errati, testo minuscolo, promessa di eliminare ogni inquinante, logo, filigrana.
```

# 日本語 FLUX 3 プロンプト（`ja-JP`）

言語間で結果を比較できるよう、シーン ID、時間、カメラ、連続性を統一した 3 つの完全ローカライズ例です。

## I18N-01 — オフィス植物の人事評価

```text
形式：9:16、15 秒、淡々としたコメディー、自然な日本語会話。

場面：昼の小さな会議室。ベージュのカーディガンを着た疲れ気味の会社員が、元気なゴムの木と向かい合って座る。閉じたノート PC と水の入ったグラスはテーブル中央から動かさない。スマートフォンのカメラは固定。

00:00-00:05 — 白紙を確認し、植物を見て正確に言う。「今期の成長は、非常に優秀でした。」
00:05-00:10 — 植物だけの不自然に長いリアクションショット。空調が動き出したときだけ、葉が一枚揺れる。
00:10-00:15 — 会社員に戻る。グラスを植物へ滑らせ、正確に言う。「利用できる資源を増やします。」最後に真剣な小さなうなずき。

音声：蛍光灯、遠いプリンター、自然な会話、グラスの摩擦、空調の作動音。音楽と笑い声はなし。

避ける：植物の顔、追加人物、字幕、追加台詞、変化する小物、ロゴ、透かし。
```

## I18N-02 — 8 つの動作で組み立てる

```text
モード：画像から動画。画像 1 だけを製品参照として使う。
形式：4:5、20 秒、自然な組み立て音。

固定：明るいオーク材のサイドテーブル、丸みのある三角形の天板、先細りの脚 3 本、黒い金具 3 個、ロック 2 個、木目、比率、部品数。

00:00-00:04 — 真上。全部品を一度ずつ分解配置で見せる。
00:04-00:12 — 斜め 3/4 の近接。金具 3 個を挿入、脚 3 本を設置、ロック 2 個を回す計 8 動作を明確に見せる。接触を編集で隠さない。
00:12-00:17 — テーブルを起こし、各角を一度押し、満水のグラスを置いて安定性を示す。
00:17-00:20 — 右側に余白を残す安定した製品ショット。文字は生成しない。

音声：木材、金属のクリック、ロック、設置、グラス。声と音楽はなし。

避ける：魔法の自動組立、余分なねじ、不自然な手、変化する木目、ロゴ、字幕、透かし。
```

## I18N-03 — 都市が雨を受け止める仕組み

```text
形式：16:9、20 秒、粘土と透明樹脂の教育用模型。

00:00-00:06 — 街区に雨が降る。青い水が側溝から縁石の開口部へ流れる。正確な文字を一度だけ表示：「1 · 集める」。
00:06-00:13 — 地下断面へ移動。水が 3 層を通過し、それぞれ一度だけ表示：「マルチ」「砂質土」「砂利」。
00:13-00:20 — 水が根の間からゆっくり浸透し、道路の冠水が収まる。正確な最終文字：「遅らせる · ろ過する · 浸透させる」。

正確なナレーション：「雨庭は流出する雨水を遅らせ、土と根でごみをこし取り、水が地面に浸透する時間をつくります。」

音声：静かな雨、模型素材の音、明瞭な日本語ナレーション、ごく小さなマリンバ。

避ける：上向きに流れる水、誤った配管、小さすぎる文字、全汚染物質を除去する主張、ロゴ、透かし。
```

# 한국어 FLUX 3 프롬프트 (`ko-KR`)

언어별 결과를 비교할 수 있도록 장면 ID, 시간 구성, 카메라와 연속성을 동일하게 유지한 세 가지 완전 현지화 테스트입니다.

## I18N-01 — 사무실 화분의 인사 평가

```text
형식: 9:16, 15초, 건조한 코미디, 자연스러운 한국어 대사.

장면: 점심시간의 평범한 소회의실. 베이지색 카디건을 입은 지친 직장인이 건강한 고무나무 화분과 마주 앉아 있다. 닫힌 노트북과 물 한 잔은 테이블 중앙에 그대로 둔다. 휴대폰 카메라는 고정한다.

00:00-00:05 — 빈 종이를 확인한 뒤 화분을 바라보며 정확히 말한다. "이번 분기 성장 실적이 아주 뛰어났습니다."
00:05-00:10 — 화분만 길게 보여 준다. 에어컨이 켜지면서 잎 한 장만 움직인다.
00:10-00:15 — 직장인으로 돌아온다. 물잔을 화분 쪽으로 밀며 정확히 말한다. "지원 자원을 늘리겠습니다." 진지하게 작게 고개를 끄덕이며 끝낸다.

오디오: 형광등 소리, 멀리서 들리는 프린터, 자연스러운 대사, 유리잔 마찰, 에어컨 클릭. 음악과 웃음 효과 없음.

피하기: 얼굴이 생기는 화분, 추가 인물, 자막, 추가 문구, 바뀌는 소품, 로고, 워터마크.
```

## I18N-02 — 여덟 동작으로 완성하는 테이블

```text
모드: 이미지 투 비디오. 이미지 1만 제품 기준으로 사용한다.
형식: 4:5, 20초, 실제 조립 소리.

고정 요소: 밝은 오크 사이드 테이블, 둥근 삼각형 상판, 가늘어지는 다리 세 개, 검은 브래킷 세 개, 잠금 장치 두 개, 나뭇결, 비율과 부품 수.

00:00-00:04 — 탑뷰. 모든 부품을 한 번씩만 펼쳐 놓는다.
00:04-00:12 — 3/4 근접 샷. 브래킷 세 개 삽입, 다리 세 개 장착, 잠금 장치 두 개 회전의 여덟 동작을 또렷하게 보여 준다. 접촉 순간을 컷으로 숨기지 않는다.
00:12-00:17 — 테이블을 바로 세우고 각 모서리를 한 번씩 누른 다음 물이 찬 유리잔을 올린다.
00:17-00:20 — 오른쪽에 여백을 둔 안정적인 제품 샷. 생성 텍스트 없음.

오디오: 나무 접촉, 금속 클릭, 잠금 회전, 테이블과 유리잔 소리. 음성과 음악 없음.

피하기: 마법 같은 자동 조립, 추가 나사, 비정상적인 손, 변하는 나뭇결, 로고, 자막, 워터마크.
```

## I18N-03 — 도시는 빗물을 어떻게 흡수할까

```text
형식: 16:9, 20초, 점토와 투명 레진으로 만든 교육용 모형.

00:00-00:06 — 도시 한 블록에 비가 내린다. 파란 물이 배수로를 따라 연석 입구로 흐른다. 정확한 표시: "1 · 모으기".
00:06-00:13 — 지하 단면으로 이동한다. 물이 세 층을 통과하며 각 표시는 한 번만 나온다: "멀칭", "모래질 흙", "자갈".
00:13-00:20 — 물이 뿌리 사이로 천천히 스며들고 도로의 범람이 멈춘다. 마지막 정확한 문구: "늦추고 · 거르고 · 스며들게".

정확한 내레이션: "빗물 정원은 빗물의 흐름을 늦추고, 흙과 뿌리로 이물질을 걸러 내며, 물이 땅으로 스며들 시간을 줍니다."

오디오: 잔잔한 빗소리, 모형 재질 소리, 또렷한 내레이션, 매우 작은 마림바 음.

피하기: 위로 흐르는 물, 잘못된 배관, 작은 글자, 모든 오염 물질이 제거된다는 주장, 로고, 워터마크.
```

## Flaq AI 제휴 프로그램

개발자, 크리에이터, 교육자, 에이전트 빌더와 모델 리뷰어는 [Flaq AI 제휴 프로그램](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/)에 가입해 개인 추천 링크를 만들고, 조건을 충족하는 추천 주문에서 수수료를 받을 수 있습니다. 현재 공개 조건은 추천 사용자의 **첫 번째 유효 유료 주문에 20%**, 등록 후 60일의 귀속 기간 안에 발생한 **후속 유효 유료 주문에 10%**입니다. 최종 지급액은 귀속 상태, 환불, 지불 거절, 위험 검토와 현행 정책에 따라 달라집니다. [제휴 프로그램 가이드](../docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md)를 확인하고 제휴 관계를 명확히 공개하세요.

# Prompts FLUX 3 em português do Brasil (`pt-BR`)

Três cenas de teste totalmente localizadas. IDs, tempo, câmera e continuidade permanecem iguais para permitir comparação entre idiomas.

## I18N-01 — Avaliação de desempenho da planta

```text
FORMATO: 9:16, 15 segundos, comédia seca, diálogo em português brasileiro natural.

CENA: Sala de reunião comum ao meio-dia. Uma funcionária cansada, de cardigã bege, está sentada diante de uma seringueira saudável. Um notebook fechado e um copo de água permanecem no centro da mesa. Câmera de celular fixa.

00:00-00:05 — Ela consulta uma folha em branco, olha para a planta e diz exatamente: "Seu crescimento neste trimestre foi excepcional."
00:05-00:10 — Plano de reação desconfortavelmente longo da planta. Uma folha se move apenas quando o ar-condicionado liga.
00:10-00:15 — Volta para a funcionária. Ela desliza o copo até a planta e diz exatamente: "Vamos aumentar seus recursos." Termina com um pequeno aceno sério.

ÁUDIO: Zumbido das lâmpadas, impressora distante, fala natural, copo na mesa, clique do ar-condicionado. Sem música ou risadas.

EVITAR: rosto na planta, pessoas extras, legendas, palavras adicionais, objetos mudando, logotipo, marca-d'água.
```

## I18N-02 — Montagem em oito movimentos

```text
MODO: Imagem para vídeo. A Imagem 1 é a única referência do produto.
FORMATO: 4:5, 20 segundos, efeitos sonoros naturais.

PRESERVAR: Mesa lateral de carvalho claro, tampo triangular arredondado, três pés afunilados, três suportes pretos, duas travas, veios da madeira, proporções e número de peças.

00:00-00:04 — Vista superior. Todas as peças aparecem uma única vez, organizadas em vista explodida.
00:04-00:12 — Close em três quartos. Mostrar oito movimentos claros: inserir três suportes, encaixar três pés e girar duas travas. Não esconder o contato com cortes.
00:12-00:17 — Virar a mesa, pressionar cada canto uma vez e colocar um copo cheio para demonstrar estabilidade.
00:17-00:20 — Plano estável do produto com espaço livre à direita. Não gerar texto.

ÁUDIO: Madeira, clique metálico, travas, mesa apoiada e copo. Sem voz ou música.

EVITAR: automontagem mágica, parafusos extras, mãos impossíveis, mudança dos veios, logotipo, legenda, marca-d'água.
```

## I18N-03 — Como a cidade absorve a chuva

```text
FORMATO: 16:9, 20 segundos, maquete explicativa de argila e resina transparente.

00:00-00:06 — Chove sobre um quarteirão. A água azul segue a sarjeta até a abertura no meio-fio. Texto exato: "1 · COLETAR".
00:06-00:13 — Corte subterrâneo. A água atravessa três camadas distintas, cada uma rotulada uma vez: "COBERTURA", "SOLO ARENOSO", "CASCALHO".
00:13-00:20 — A água infiltra lentamente entre as raízes e a rua deixa de alagar. Texto final exato: "REDUZIR · FILTRAR · INFILTRAR".

NARRAÇÃO EXATA: "Um jardim de chuva reduz o escoamento, filtra resíduos com o solo e as raízes e dá tempo para a água infiltrar no terreno."

ÁUDIO: Chuva leve, sons da maquete, narração clara e marimba muito discreta.

EVITAR: água subindo, tubulação incorreta, texto pequeno, promessa de remover toda poluição, logotipo, marca-d'água.
```

## Programa de afiliados da Flaq AI

Desenvolvedores, criadores, educadores, construtores de agentes e avaliadores de modelos podem participar do [programa de afiliados da Flaq AI](https://flaq.ai/affiliate-program/), criar um link pessoal de indicação e receber comissão sobre pedidos elegíveis. As condições públicas atuais oferecem **20% no primeiro pedido pago válido** do usuário indicado e **10% nos pedidos pagos válidos seguintes** feitos dentro de 60 dias após o cadastro. O pagamento final depende da atribuição, reembolsos, estornos, análise de risco e política vigente. Consulte o [guia do programa](../docs/flaq-ai-affiliate-program.md) e divulgue claramente a relação de afiliado.

# Промпты FLUX 3 на русском (`ru-RU`)

Три полностью локализованные тестовые сцены. Идентификаторы, тайминг, камера и непрерывность одинаковы во всех языках.

## I18N-01 — Аттестация офисного растения

```text
ФОРМАТ: 9:16, 15 секунд, сдержанная комедия, естественная русская речь.

СЦЕНА: Обычная небольшая переговорная в полдень. Уставшая сотрудница в бежевом кардигане сидит напротив здорового фикуса. Закрытый ноутбук и стакан воды остаются в центре стола. Камера телефона неподвижна.

00:00-00:05 — Она изучает чистый лист, смотрит на растение и произносит дословно: «Ваш рост в этом квартале был исключительным.»
00:05-00:10 — Нарочито длинный ответный план растения. Один лист двигается только из-за включившегося кондиционера.
00:10-00:15 — Снова сотрудница. Она подвигает стакан к растению и произносит дословно: «Мы увеличим доступные вам ресурсы.» В конце — короткий серьёзный кивок.

ЗВУК: Гул ламп, далёкий принтер, естественная речь, скольжение стакана, щелчок кондиционера. Без музыки и закадрового смеха.

ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: лицо у растения, лишних людей, субтитры, дополнительные слова, меняющиеся предметы, логотип, водяной знак.
```

## I18N-02 — Сборка за восемь движений

```text
РЕЖИМ: Изображение в видео. Изображение 1 — единственный эталон изделия.
ФОРМАТ: 4:5, 20 секунд, естественные шумы.

СОХРАНИТЬ: Светлый дубовый столик, скруглённую треугольную столешницу, три сужающиеся ножки, три чёрных кронштейна, два фиксатора, рисунок дерева, пропорции и число деталей.

00:00-00:04 — Вид сверху. Все детали показаны по одному разу в разнесённой схеме.
00:04-00:12 — Крупный план в три четверти. Восемь ясных движений: вставить три кронштейна, установить три ножки, повернуть два фиксатора. Не скрывать контакт монтажными склейками.
00:12-00:17 — Перевернуть стол, нажать на каждый угол и поставить полный стакан воды для проверки устойчивости.
00:17-00:20 — Стабильный вид изделия со свободным местом справа. Не генерировать текст.

ЗВУК: Дерево, металлический щелчок, фиксаторы, установка стола, стакан. Без речи и музыки.

ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: волшебную самосборку, лишние винты, невозможные руки, меняющийся рисунок дерева, логотип, подписи, водяной знак.
```

## I18N-03 — Как город впитывает дождь

```text
ФОРМАТ: 16:9, 20 секунд, учебный макет из глины и прозрачной смолы.

00:00-00:06 — Дождь падает на городской квартал. Синяя вода течёт по желобу к отверстию в бордюре. Точная надпись: «1 · СОБРАТЬ».
00:06-00:13 — Подземный разрез. Вода проходит три чётких слоя с однократными подписями: «МУЛЬЧА», «ПЕСЧАНАЯ ПОЧВА», «ГРАВИЙ».
00:13-00:20 — Вода медленно впитывается между корнями, улица перестаёт затапливаться. Точный финальный текст: «ЗАМЕДЛИТЬ · ОТФИЛЬТРОВАТЬ · ВПИТАТЬ».

ТОЧНЫЙ ТЕКСТ ДИКТОРА: «Дождевой сад замедляет сток, задерживает мусор почвой и корнями и даёт воде время впитаться в землю.»

ЗВУК: Тихий дождь, звуки макета, ясный голос, едва слышная маримба.

ИСКЛЮЧИТЬ: воду, текущую вверх, неверные трубы, мелкий текст, обещание удалить все загрязнения, логотип, водяной знак.
```

# 简体中文 FLUX 3 提示词（`zh-CN`）

以下三个场景采用统一 ID、时间线和连续性规则，可用于横向比较不同语言的指令理解、对白和文字渲染。

## I18N-01 — 办公室绿植绩效评估

```text
格式：9:16，15 秒，冷面喜剧，自然普通话对白。

场景：中午的普通小会议室。一名穿米色开衫、神情疲惫的职员与一盆健康的橡皮树相对而坐。合上的笔记本电脑和一杯水始终位于桌面中央。手机镜头完全固定。

00:00-00:05 — 她查看一张空白纸，认真看向绿植，只说这一句：“你本季度的增长表现非常出色。”
00:05-00:10 — 不合时宜地长时间停留在绿植的反应镜头。只有空调启动时，一片叶子轻轻移动。
00:10-00:15 — 切回职员。她把水杯推向绿植，只说这一句：“我们会增加你的可用资源。”最后严肃地点一下头。

音频：灯管底噪、远处打印机、自然对白、杯底摩擦、空调启动声。不要音乐和罐头笑声。

避免：绿植长出五官、多余职员、字幕、额外对白、桌面道具变化、公司标志、水印。
```

## I18N-02 — 八个动作完成组装

```text
模式：图生视频。图片 1 是唯一产品参考。
格式：4:5，20 秒，原生组装拟音。

锁定：浅色橡木边桌、圆角三角形桌面、三条锥形桌腿、三个黑色支架、两个锁扣、木纹、比例与零件数量。

00:00-00:04 — 顶视角。所有零件各出现一次，整齐排成爆炸图。
00:04-00:12 — 三分之四近景。清楚展示八个动作：插入三个支架、安装三条桌腿、旋转两个锁扣。不得用剪辑掩盖接触过程。
00:12-00:17 — 把桌子翻正，依次按压三个角，再放上一杯满水证明稳定性。
00:17-00:20 — 稳定产品镜头，右侧留出后期文案空间。不要生成文字。

音频：木材接触、金属咔哒声、锁扣旋转、桌子落地、玻璃杯轻触。不要人声和音乐。

避免：魔法自动组装、多余螺丝、异常手指、木纹改变、品牌标志、字幕、水印。
```

## I18N-03 — 城市如何吸收雨水

```text
格式：16:9，20 秒，黏土与透明树脂制作的教学模型。

00:00-00:06 — 雨落在一个城市街区。蓝色水流沿排水沟进入路缘开口。只显示一次准确文字：“1 · 收集”。
00:06-00:13 — 镜头进入地下剖面。水依次穿过三个明显不同的层次，每个标签只出现一次：“覆盖层”“砂质土”“碎石层”。
00:13-00:20 — 水在植物根系之间缓慢渗入地下，街道路面积水消退。准确结尾文字：“减速 · 过滤 · 渗透”。

精确旁白：“雨水花园能够减缓地表径流，让土壤和根系拦截杂物，并给雨水留出渗入地下的时间。”

音频：轻柔雨声、模型材质拟音、清晰普通话旁白、极轻的马林巴琴音。

避免：水向上流动、错误管线、过小文字、宣称清除所有污染物、品牌标志、水印。
```

> (عرض ▸ لوحة الأوامر ▸ *Codespaces: Stop Codespace*).

## 2.  إنشاء Codespace (بنقرة واحدة)

تستغرق هذه العملية **حوالي دقيقتين** في المرة الأولى.

## 3. أضف مفتاح API الخاص بك (الطريقة الآمنة)

### الخيار أ أسرار Codespaces — موصى به

1. ⚙️ أيقونة الترس -> لوحة الأوامر -> Codespaces : إدارة سر المستخدم -> إضافة سر جديد.
2. الاسم: OPENAI_API_KEY
3. القيمة: ألصق المفتاح → إضافة السر

هذا كل شيء — سيستخدم رمزنا المفتاح تلقائيًا.

### الخيار ب ملف .env (إذا كنت بحاجة فعلًا إلى واحد)

```bash
cp .env.copy .env
code .env         # قم بملء OPENAI_API_KEY=مفتاحك_هنا

Ponytail

He says nothing. He writes one line. It works.

~54% less code (up to 94%) · ~20% cheaper · ~27% faster · 100% safe
Measured on real Claude Code sessions editing a real open-source repo (FastAPI + React), against the same agent with no skill. ~54% is the mean across 12 feature tasks (Haiku 4.5, n=4); it reaches 94% where an agent over-builds (a date picker) and is near zero where the code is already minimal. ponytail keeps every safety guard while a bare "write one-liners" prompt drops one. (The earlier single-shot benchmark reported 80-94% as a flat figure; against a fair agentic baseline that is the per-task ceiling, not the average.) Full writeup · reproduce it.

Español · 한국어

---

You know him. Long ponytail. Oval glasses. Has been at the company longer than the version control. You show him fifty lines; he looks at them, says nothing, and replaces them with one. Ponytail puts him inside your AI agent. ## Before / after You ask for a date picker. Your agent installs flatpickr, writes a wrapper component, adds a stylesheet, and starts a discussion about timezones. With ponytail: ```html ``` More survivors in [examples/](examples/). ## Numbers The honest measurement is a real agent doing real work: a headless Claude Code session editing [tiangolo's full-stack-fastapi-template](https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template) (a real FastAPI + React repo), scored on the `git diff` it leaves behind. Twelve feature tickets, the same agent with and without the skill, n=4, Haiku 4.5.

| vs no-skill baseline | LOC | tokens | cost | time | safe | |---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | **ponytail** | **-54%** | **-22%** | **-20%** | **-27%** | **100%** | | caveman (terse-prose control) | -20% | +7% | +3% | +2% | 100% | | "YAGNI + one-liners" prompt | -33% | -14% | -21% | -30% | 95% | ponytail is the only arm that cuts every metric, and the only one that stays fully safe while doing it. The cut is biggest where there is a real over-build trap (date picker 404 to 23 lines, color picker 287 to 23, because it reaches for a native `` instead of a component) and near zero on code that is already minimal. Full method, per-task tables, and limitations: [benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md](benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md).
Older single-shot numbers (isolated generation) Five everyday tasks, three models, three arms (no skill, [caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman), ponytail), ten runs, median reported. One prompt, one completion, counting lines of the answer:

This showed **80-94% less code**. [#126](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/issues/126) fairly pointed out that the bare-model baseline pads its answer with prose and options, so that gap is partly a conversational-baseline artifact. The agentic numbers above are the corrected, defensible version. Reproduce the single-shot run with `npx promptfoo eval -c benchmarks/promptfooconfig.yaml`.
**The rule was never "fewest tokens."** It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. The code ends up small because it is necessary, not golfed. Lower cost and latency are a side effect on the models that follow the ladder; a terse reasoning model that spends thinking tokens deliberating the rungs can go the other way (on GPT-5.5 it does). ## How it works Before writing code, the agent stops at the first rung that holds: ``` 1. Does this need to exist? → no: skip it (YAGNI) 2. Already in this codebase? → reuse it, don't rewrite 3. Stdlib does it? → use it 4. Native platform feature? → use it 5. Installed dependency? → use it 6. One line? → one line 7. Only then: the minimum that works ``` The ladder runs *after* it understands the problem, not instead of it: it reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow before picking a rung. Lazy about the solution, never about reading. Lazy, not negligent: trust-boundary validation, data-loss handling, security, and accessibility are never on the chopping block. ## Install The most effort ponytail will ever ask of you: The Claude Code and Codex plugins run two tiny Node.js lifecycle hooks, so `node` needs to be on your PATH (note for Nix/nvm users: it must be on the non-interactive shell's PATH). If it isn't, the skills still work, the always-on activation just stays quiet instead of erroring on every prompt. ### Claude Code ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` ``` /plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` (You have to send two separate prompts for the install to work) Same steps in the Claude Code Desktop app's Code tab: type the two `/plugin` commands above into the prompt box, or click the **+** button next to it, choose **Plugins** → **Add plugin** to browse your configured marketplaces, and manage marketplaces from **Customize** in the sidebar. ### Codex ```bash codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail ``` Run `codex` and open `/hooks`, review and trust its two lifecycle hooks, and start a new thread. This same install also covers the Codex desktop app: restart the app after installing and it picks up the plugin. ### GitHub Copilot CLI ```bash copilot plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail copilot plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` In an interactive Copilot CLI session, use the slash equivalents: ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert

Ponytail

말이 없다. 한 줄을 쓴다. 돌아간다.

코드 약 54% 감소(최대 94%) · 약 20% 저렴 · 약 27% 빠름 · 100% 안전
실제 오픈소스 저장소(FastAPI + React)를 고치는 실제 Claude Code 세션에서, 스킬을 끈 같은 에이전트와 견줘 측정했다. 약 54%는 기능 작업 12건의 평균이다(Haiku 4.5, n=4). 에이전트가 과하게 짤 여지가 있는 곳(날짜 선택기)에선 94%까지 오르고, 코드가 이미 최소한인 곳에선 0에 가깝다. ponytail은 안전 가드를 하나도 빼놓지 않지만, 그냥 "한 줄로 써"라고만 시킨 프롬프트는 그중 하나를 놓친다. (예전 단발성 벤치마크는 80-94%를 단일 수치로 내세웠는데, 공정한 에이전트 기준선에 견주면 그건 평균이 아니라 작업별 상한이다.) 전체 보고서 · 직접 재현하기.

커뮤니티 번역이다. 기준이 되는 최신 버전은 영어 README다.

---

이런 사람, 다들 알 거다. 긴 포니테일에 타원형 안경. 버전 관리 시스템보다 회사에 오래 있었다. 코드 쉰 줄을 들이밀면 잠깐 보더니, 말없이 한 줄로 바꿔 놓는다. Ponytail은 그를 당신의 AI 에이전트 안에 앉혀 둔다. ## Before / after 날짜 선택기 하나 만들어 달라고 한다. 에이전트는 flatpickr를 깔고, 래퍼 컴포넌트를 짜고, 스타일시트를 붙이더니, 타임존 얘기를 꺼내기 시작한다. ponytail이라면: ```html ``` 살아남은 것들이 더 궁금하다면 [examples/](examples/)로. ## Numbers 공정하게 재려면 실제 에이전트에게 실질적인 작업을 시켜 봐야 한다. 헤드리스 Claude Code 세션에게 [tiangolo의 full-stack-fastapi-template](https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template)(진짜 FastAPI + React 저장소)을 맡기고, 남긴 `git diff`로 점수를 매겼다. 기능 티켓 12건, 같은 에이전트를 스킬만 켜고 끄며 비교, n=4, Haiku 4.5.

| 스킬 없는 기준선 대비 | LOC | tokens | cost | time | safe | |---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | **ponytail** | **-54%** | **-22%** | **-20%** | **-27%** | **100%** | | caveman (간결한 산문 대조군) | -20% | +7% | +3% | +2% | 100% | | "YAGNI + one-liners" 프롬프트 | -33% | -14% | -21% | -30% | 95% | 모든 지표를 깎은 건 ponytail뿐이고, 그러면서 안전까지 온전히 지킨 것도 ponytail뿐이다. 깎이는 폭은 과잉 구현의 함정이 실제로 있는 곳에서 가장 크다. 컴포넌트 대신 네이티브 ``으로 손이 가니 날짜 선택기는 404줄에서 23줄로, 색상 선택기는 287줄에서 23줄로 줄어든다. 반대로 이미 군더더기 없는 코드에선 거의 0이다. 전체 방법론, 작업별 표, 한계는 [benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md](benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md)에 있다.
예전 단발성 수치 (격리된 생성) 일상적인 작업 다섯 가지, 모델 셋, 비교군 셋(스킬 없음, [caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman), ponytail), 10회 실행, 중앙값 기준. 프롬프트 하나에 응답 하나, 답변의 줄 수를 셌다:

여기선 **코드 80-94% 감소**가 나왔다. 다만 [#126](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/issues/126)이 맞게 짚었듯, 스킬을 전혀 안 붙인 기준선 모델은 답변을 설명과 선택지로 부풀린다. 그래서 그 격차의 일부는 대화형 기준선이 만들어 낸 착시다. 위의 에이전트 수치가 그걸 바로잡은, 근거 있는 버전이다. 단발성 실행은 `npx promptfoo eval -c benchmarks/promptfooconfig.yaml`로 재현할 수 있다.
**규칙은 애초에 "토큰 최소화"가 아니었다.** 작업에 필요한 만큼만 쓰되, 검증·에러 처리·보안·접근성은 절대 덜어내지 않는다는 것이다. 코드가 작아지는 건 억지로 줄여서가 아니라 딱 그만큼만 필요해서다. 비용과 지연이 낮아지는 것도 단계를 충실히 밟는 모델에서나 부수적으로 딸려 오는 효과일 뿐이다. 그 단계를 고민하느라 사고 토큰을 쏟는 간결한 추론 모델은 오히려 거꾸로 갈 수도 있다(GPT-5.5가 그렇다). ## How it works 코드를 쓰기 전에, 에이전트는 가장 먼저 들어맞는 단계에서 멈춘다: ``` 1. 이게 있을 필요가 있나? → 없다: 건너뛴다 (YAGNI) 2. 이미 이 코드베이스에 있나? → 다시 짜지 말고 가져다 쓴다 3. 표준 라이브러리로 되나? → 쓴다 4. 네이티브 플랫폼 기능인가? → 쓴다 5. 깔려 있는 의존성이 푸나? → 쓴다 6. 한 줄로 되나? → 한 줄 7. 그제서야: 돌아가는 최소한 ``` 단계를 밟는 건 문제를 이해한 *다음*이지, 이해를 대신하는 게 아니다. 변경이 닿는 코드를 읽고 실제 흐름을 따라가 본 뒤에야 단계를 고른다. 해법에는 게을러도, 읽는 데는 절대 게으르지 않다. 게으른 거지 부주의한 게 아니다. 신뢰 경계의 검증, 데이터 손실 방지, 보안, 접근성은 결코 잘려 나가지 않는다. ## Install ponytail이 당신에게 요구할 수고의 최대치: Claude Code와 Codex 플러그인은 자그마한 Node.js 라이프사이클 훅 두 개를 돌리니, `node`가 PATH에 잡혀 있어야 한다(Nix/nvm 사용자라면 비대화형 셸의 PATH에 있어야 한다). 없어도 스킬은 멀쩡히 돌아간다. 다만 늘 켜져 있던 자동 활성화가 매 프롬프트마다 에러를 뱉는 대신 조용히 비활성으로 남을 뿐이다. ### Claude Code ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` ``` /plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` (설치가 되려면 두 프롬프트를 따로 보내야 한다) 데스크톱 앱에는 `/plugin` 명령이 없다. 대신 UI에서 설치한다: Customize, 개인 플러그인 옆의 +, Create plugin and add marketplace, Add from repository, 그다음 저장소 URL 입력(감사합니다 @NiklasDHahn, #98). ### Codex ```bash codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail codex ``` `/plugins`를 열어 Ponytail 마켓플레이스를 고르고 Ponytail을 설치한다. 그런 다음 `/hooks`를 열어 라이프사이클 훅 두 개를 검토하고 신뢰한 뒤, 새 스레드를 시작한다. 이 설치 한 번이면 Codex 데스크톱 앱도 같이 잡힌다. 설치 후 앱을 다시 켜면 플러그인을 알아챈다. ### GitHub Copilot CLI ```bash copilot plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail copilot plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` 대화형 Copilot CLI 세션에서는 슬래시 명령으로 똑같이 하면 된다: ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail /plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` Copilot CLI는 플러그인 명령에 그 이름을 네임스페이스로 붙인다. 예를 들면: ```text /ponytail:ponytail ultra /ponytail:ponytail-review ``` ### Pi agent harness ``` pi install git:github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` ### OpenCode `opencode.json`에 다음을 더한다: ```json { "plugin": ["@dietrichgebert/ponytail"] } ``` 체크아웃에서 직접 돌려도 된다(플러그인이 `hooks/`와 `skills/`를 그대로 쓴다): ```json { "plugin": ["./.opencode/plugins/ponytail.mjs"] } ``` 매 턴마다 지금 레벨의 룰셋을 주입하고, `/ponytail` 명령들을 붙여 준다([Commands](#commands) 참고). OpenCode는 이 저장소의 `AGENTS.md`도 알아서 불러오니, 플러그인이 없어도 규칙은 살아 있다. 플러그인은 `lite/full/ultra/off` 레벨을 얹어 준다. `./` 경로는 프로젝트의 `opencode.json`을 기준으로 풀린다. 체크아웃 하나를 여러 프로젝트에서 같이 쓰려면, 대신 `.mjs`의 절대 경로를 가리키면 된다(그 파일은 제 위치를 기준으로 `hooks/`와 `skills/`를 찾는다). ### Gemini CLI ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` 매 세션 룰셋을 늘 켜진 컨텍스트로 불러오고 `/ponytail` 명령들을 등록한다. `skills/`도 함께 실리며, 작업에 필요할 때 켜진다. Gemini 어댑터는 일부러 루트 `hooks/hooks.json`을 두지 않는다. Gemini는 그 경로를 자동으로 불러오는데, ponytail의 라이프사이클 훅은 Claude/Codex 이벤트 이름을 쓰기 때문이다. ### Antigravity CLI Google이 Gemini CLI를 Antigravity CLI(`agy` 바이너리)로 이름을 바꾸는 중인데, 같은 확장이 거기에도 설치된다: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` 이 저장소의 `gemini-extension.json`을 그대로 재사용한다. 차이는 하나다. Antigravity는 `/ponytail` 명령들을 스킬로 바꿔 버려서, 슬래시 메뉴에서 고르는 대신 채팅에 직접 친다(예: `/ponytail-review`를 메시지로). 전환이 마무리될 때까지(2026년 6월 18일경)는 `gemini extensions install`도 여전히 먹힌다. 늘 켜진 규칙으로 돌리고 싶으면, 룰셋을 `.agents/rules/`에 넣으면 된다. ### CodeWhale 프로젝트 루트의 `AGENTS.md`를 읽고, 설정은 전혀 필요 없다. [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)를 프로젝트에 복사하거나, 이 저장소를 체크아웃한 곳에서 `codewhale`을 돌리면 된다. 그게 끝이다. ### Swival 먼저 컬렉션을 라이브러리에 스테이징한 다음, 원하는 스킬을 더한다: ```bash swival skills add --global https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail # ~/.config/swival/library에 스테이징 swival skills add ponytail # 이 프로젝트에 컬렉션 설치 swival skills add --global ponytail # 또는 모든 프로젝트에서 켜기 ``` Swival도 프로젝트 루트의 `AGENTS.md`와 전역의 `~/.config/swival/AGENTS.md`를 읽는다. 지시문 전용 폴백이다. 명령줄에서는 `$` 접두사로 스킬을 명시적으로 켠다. 예: `$ponytail-review`. ### Devin CLI ```bash devin plugins install DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` ponytail을 Devin 플러그인으로 설치한다. 스킬은 `/ponytail:ponytail`, `/ponytail:ponytail-review` 등으로 쓸 수 있다. ### OpenClaw ```bash clawhub install ponytail ``` ClawHub에서 ponytail을 OpenClaw 스킬로 설치한다. review, audit, debt, gain, help 스킬도 같은 식으로 깐다(`clawhub install ponytail-review` 등). OpenClaw는 코딩 작업에 이를 적용하고 `/ponytail` 명령으로도 열어 준다. ClawHub가 없으면 [`.openclaw/skills/ponytail`](.openclaw/skills/)을 `~/.openclaw/skills/`에 복사하면 된다. ### Grok Build ```bash grok plugin install DietrichGebert/ponytail --trust ``` 플러그인은 기본이 꺼져 있다. `/plugins` → Plugins에서 `ponytail`에 Space, 또는 `~/.grok/config.toml`: ```toml [plugins] enabled = ["ponytail"] ``` 새 세션을 열거나 플러그인을 다시 로드한다. 스킬은 `/ponytail`, `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`, `/ponytail-debt`, `/ponytail-gain`, `/ponytail-help`로 보인다. `grok inspect`로 확인. Grok은 스킬 설명을 바탕으로 코딩 작업에서 ponytail을 자동으로 호출할 수 있다. 명시적으로 활성화해야 하면 `/ponytail`(또는 `/ponytail lite`, `/ponytail full`, `/ponytail ultra`)을 사용한다. `SessionStart` 출력으로는 지시문을 주입할 수 없으므로 Grok 라이프사이클 훅은 사용하지 않는다. 체크아웃의 `AGENTS.md`만으로도 지시문 전용 모드는 된다. 제거: `grok plugin uninstall ponytail`. 이게 끝이었다. 그 사람이라면 흐뭇해할 거다. 입 밖으로 내진 않겠지만. 매 세션 켜져 있고, 명령 몇 개가 딸려 온다([Commands](#commands) 참고). `/ponytail ultra`는 코드베이스가 당신에게 단단히 밉보인 날을 위해 있다. 시작할 때와 모드를 바꿀 때 지금 모드를 보여 준다. 새 세션마다 적용할 레벨은 `PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE` 환경 변수(`lite`/`full`/`ultra`/`off`)로, 또는 `~/.config/ponytail/config.json`의 `defaultMode` 필드(Windows에선 `%APPDATA%\ponytail\config.json`)로 정한다. 기본값은 `full`이다. Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, GitHub Copilot(에디터), Aider, Kiro, Zed, CodeWhale: 이 저장소에서 맞는 규칙 파일을 복사하면 된다([`.cursor/rules/`](.cursor/rules/), [`.windsurf/rules/`](.windsurf/rules/), [`.clinerules/`](.clinerules/), [`.github/copilot-instructions.md`](.github/copilot-instructions.md), [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md), [`.kiro/steering/`](.kiro/steering/)). Kiro: `.kiro/steering/ponytail.md`를 `~/.kiro/steering/`(전역)이나 프로젝트의 `.kiro/steering/`에 복사한다. GitHub Copilot CLI 폴백(지시문 전용 모드): 프로젝트의 `AGENTS.md`와 `.github/copilot-instructions.md`를 읽거나, 모든 프로젝트에서 ponytail을 돌리려면 규칙을 `~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md`에 복사한다. 이 경로는 늘 켜진 가이드는 살리지만, 플러그인 모드 전환이나 훅은 더해 주지 않는다. Codex 확장을 쓰는 VS Code는 이 저장소가 함께 싣는 `AGENTS.md`를 읽으니, 저장소 루트에서 설정 없이 돌아간다(`~/.codex/AGENTS.md`를 두면 Codex 전역으로 잡힌다). 어떤 파일이 어느 에이전트에 매핑되는지: [Agent portability](docs/agent-portability.md). ## Commands | 명령 | 하는 일 | |---------|--------------| | `/ponytail [lite \| full \| ultra \| off]` | 강도를 정하거나, 끈다. 인수가 없으면 지금 레벨을 알려 준다. | | `/ponytail-review` | 지금 diff를 과잉 구현 관점에서 훑고, 삭제 목록을 돌려준다. | | `/ponytail-audit` | diff만이 아니라 저장소 전체를 과잉 구현 관점에서 감사한다. | | `/ponytail-debt` | 미뤄 둔 `ponytail:` 간소화들을 장부로 모아, "나중에"가 "영영"이 되지 않게 한다. | | `/ponytail-gain` | 벤치마크로 잰 효과 스코어보드(코드 절감, 비용 절감, 속도 향상)를 보여 준다. | | `/ponytail-help` | 위 명령들의 빠른 참조. | 명령들은 스킬을 지원하는 호스트가 있어야 돈다(Claude Code, Codex, Devin CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, pi, Swival). Codex에선 스킬이라 `@`로 부른다(`@ponytail-review`). 지시문 전용 어댑터(Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, Kiro, Antigravity)는 명령 없이 늘 켜진 룰셋만 불러온다. ## Development 압축 규칙 텍스트를 바꿀 때는, 에이전트 사본들을 같은 상태로 맞춰 둔다: ```bash node scripts/check-rule-copies.js npm test ``` OpenClaw 스킬 패키지(`.openclaw/skills/`)는 `skills/`에서 생성된다. 스킬을 바꾼 뒤에는 `node scripts/build-openclaw-skills.js`를 다시 돌린다. 묵은 상태면 테스트 스위트가 실패한다. 정확성 벤치마크는 이메일·CSV 검사를 위해 Python을 띄운다. `python`보다 `python3`를 먼저 시도한다. CSV 검사는 로컬에 `pandas`가 깔려 있어야 한다. ## FAQ **설정 파일이 필요한가?** 아니다. 선택 사항인 `~/.config/ponytail/config.json`이나 `PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE` 환경 변수로 기본 레벨을 정할 순 있지만, 꼭 있어야 하는 건 없다. **그래도 120줄짜리 캐시 클래스가 정말 필요하다면?** 필요 없다. 그래도 우기면 그가 만들어 준다. 천천히. 정확하게. 당신을 쳐다보면서. **확장은 되나?** 당신이 안 쓴 코드는 무한히 확장된다. 버그 0, CVE 0, 가동률 100%. 예나 지금이나. **왜 하필 "ponytail"인가?** 당신은 이유를 정확히 안다. ## Sponsors

readme:
Ponytail

He says nothing. He writes one line. It works.

~54% less code (up to 94%) · ~20% cheaper · ~27% faster · 100% safe
Measured on real Claude Code sessions editing a real open-source repo (FastAPI + React), against the same agent with no skill. ~54% is the mean across 12 feature tasks (Haiku 4.5, n=4); it reaches 94% where an agent over-builds (a date picker) and is near zero where the code is already minimal. ponytail keeps every safety guard while a bare "write one-liners" prompt drops one. (The earlier single-shot benchmark reported 80-94% as a flat figure; against a fair agentic baseline that is the per-task ceiling, not the average.) Full writeup · reproduce it.

Español · 한국어

---

You know him. Long ponytail. Oval glasses. Has been at the company longer than the version control. You show him fifty lines; he looks at them, says nothing, and replaces them with one. Ponytail puts him inside your AI agent. ## Before / after You ask for a date picker. Your agent installs flatpickr, writes a wrapper component, adds a stylesheet, and starts a discussion about timezones. With ponytail: ```html ``` More survivors in [examples/](examples/). ## Numbers The honest measurement is a real agent doing real work: a headless Claude Code session editing [tiangolo's full-stack-fastapi-template](https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template) (a real FastAPI + React repo), scored on the `git diff` it leaves behind. Twelve feature tickets, the same agent with and without the skill, n=4, Haiku 4.5.

| vs no-skill baseline | LOC | tokens | cost | time | safe | |---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | **ponytail** | **-54%** | **-22%** | **-20%** | **-27%** | **100%** | | caveman (terse-prose control) | -20% | +7% | +3% | +2% | 100% | | "YAGNI + one-liners" prompt | -33% | -14% | -21% | -30% | 95% | ponytail is the only arm that cuts every metric, and the only one that stays fully safe while doing it. The cut is biggest where there is a real over-build trap (date picker 404 to 23 lines, color picker 287 to 23, because it reaches for a native `` instead of a component) and near zero on code that is already minimal. Full method, per-task tables, and limitations: [benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md](benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md).
Older single-shot numbers (isolated generation) Five everyday tasks, three models, three arms (no skill, [caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman), ponytail), ten runs, median reported. One prompt, one completion, counting lines of the answer:

This showed **80-94% less code**. [#126](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/issues/126) fairly pointed out that the bare-model baseline pads its answer with prose and options, so that gap is partly a conversational-baseline artifact. The agentic numbers above are the corrected, defensible version. Reproduce the single-shot run with `npx promptfoo eval -c benchmarks/promptfooconfig.yaml`.
**The rule was never "fewest tokens."** It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. The code ends up small because it is necessary, not golfed. Lower cost and latency are a side effect on the models that follow the ladder; a terse reasoning model that spends thinking tokens deliberating the rungs can go the other way (on GPT-5.5 it does). ## How it works Before writing code, the agent stops at the first rung that holds: ``` 1. Does this need to exist? → no: skip it (YAGNI) 2. Already in this codebase? → reuse it, don't rewrite 3. Stdlib does it? → use it 4. Native platform feature? → use it 5. Installed dependency? → use it 6. One line? → one line 7. Only then: the minimum that works ``` The ladder runs *after* it understands the problem, not instead of it: it reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow before picking a rung. Lazy about the solution, never about reading. Lazy, not negligent: trust-boundary validation, data-loss handling, security, and accessibility are never on the chopping block. ## Install The most effort ponytail will ever ask of you: The Claude Code and Codex plugins run two tiny Node.js lifecycle hooks, so `node` needs to be on your PATH (note for Nix/nvm users: it must be on the non-interactive shell's PATH). If it isn't, the skills still work, the always-on activation just stays quiet instead of erroring on every prompt. ### Claude Code ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail ``` ``` /plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` (You have to send two separate prompts for the install to work) Same steps in the Claude Code Desktop app's Code tab: type the two `/plugin` commands above into the prompt box, or click the **+** button next to it, choose **Plugins** → **Add plugin** to browse your configured marketplaces, and manage marketplaces from **Customize** in the sidebar. ### Codex ```bash codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail ``` Run `codex` and open `/hooks`, review and trust its two lifecycle hooks, and start a new thread. This same install also covers the Codex desktop app: restart the app after installing and it picks up the plugin. ### GitHub Copilot CLI ```bash copilot plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail copilot plugin install ponytail@ponytail ``` In an interactive Copilot CLI session, use the slash equivalents: ``` /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert

# Ponytail for Hermes installed

Enable it if you did not install with `--enable`:

```bash
hermes plugins enable ponytail

Restart Hermes or the gateway after enabling.

- `/ponytail-review [target]`
- `/ponytail-audit [target]`
- `/ponytail-debt`
- `/ponytail-gain`
- `/ponytail-help`

Bundled skills are available as `ponytail:ponytail`, `ponytail:ponytail-review`, `ponytail:ponytail-audit`, `ponytail:ponytail-debt`, `ponytail:ponytail-gain`, and `ponytail:ponytail-help`.
